chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
The best of you is the one who is best to his family, and I am the best of you to my family.

key_terms.خَيْرُكُمْ: the best among you; the one of highest moral excellence

ai.seo_question: Who are the best people according to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a person's true excellence is shown in how he treats his family. The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله exemplifies this standard by presenting himself as the best in conduct toward his household.
